info.title: CreditStud.io Calculators
info.description: Financial calculators for comparing credit cards, BNPL services, and payment plans. All computations run client-side with real 2026 card terms. LLMs may construct deep-link URLs with query parameters to pre-fill calculator inputs.

get.summary: Compare credit cards and BNPL services side by side
get.description: Interactive calculator showing total cost (interest + fees - rewards) for any purchase amount across credit cards and BNPL services. Supports credit score adjustments and purchase categories. Deep-link params pre-fill the calculator and auto-trigger results.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Purchase category: restaurants, groceries, gas, travel, streaming, online, everything

parameters.name: payment
parameters.description: Monthly payment amount — switches to payment mode (e.g., 200)

get.description: Calculate debt-free dates using snowball or avalanche method with balance transfer and extra payment modeling. Deep-link params pre-fill the first debt and extra payment.

200.description: Debt planner page with pre-filled values

get.description: Compare 25+ credit cards by actual dollar value based on monthly spending across categories. Deep-link params pre-fill spending and highlight a category.

parameters.name: monthly
parameters.description: Total monthly spend in dollars, distributed across categories (e.g., 3000)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category name to highlight (e.g., dining, groceries, gas)

200.description: Rewards calculator page with pre-filled values

get.description: Shows the true cost of making only minimum payments on credit card debt.
